attributes.description: Incorporated in 1981, Elcid Investments Ltd is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) under the category of Investment Company. Its business is to make investments in shares, debentures, mutual funds etc.[1][2]
